comments.author: @UnrealWorldJourney1
comments.text: Sweden’s beauty comes from how dramatically the landscape changes as you travel north. 🇸🇪🌲 Southern cities and archipelagos gradually give way to huge forests, lakes and eventually Arctic environments in Lapland. What makes the country especially interesting is how infrastructure and modern life remain closely connected to nature even across such enormous distances.
